explanation: Rising in Angola's highlands, the river crosses a strip of Namibia before fanning out into the Kalahari, where nearly all its water evaporates or soaks into the sand.

claims.text: The Okavango River ends in the Okavango Delta in Botswana, without reaching the sea.
The Okavango Delta is not in Namibia, Angola or Zambia.
The Okavango River rises in the highlands of Angola.
The Okavango River crosses a narrow strip of Namibia before entering Botswana.
Nearly all of the water reaching the Okavango Delta evaporates, is used by plants or sinks into the sand.

evidence.restatement: The Okavango fans out into an inland delta in north-west Botswana and never reaches the sea.
The delta is in Botswana, not in Namibia, Angola or Zambia.
The Okavango (Cubango) rises in the Angolan highlands.
It crosses Namibia's Caprivi Strip before entering Botswana.
